description: Mercado Libre MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and AI agents — seller API tools for products, orders, pricing, stock, questions, ads, reputation and competitor analysis (write-back), official MCP proxy, Supabase multi-tenant token store, and TRAID knowledge tools

ML_CLIENT_ID.description: Auto-refresh mode: App Client ID from developers.mercadolibre.com

ML_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Auto-refresh mode: OAuth refresh token for the seller account

ML_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Direct-token mode: access token refreshed externally (n8n/cron)

ML_ACCOUNT_LABEL.description: Supabase mode: account_label row to read from oauth_tokens

ML_SITE_ID.description: ML site ID (MLA, MLU, MLB, MLC, MLM, MCO)

TRAID_CLIENT_SLUG.description: Optional: enables traid_client_context without passing a slug argument

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List seller products with price, stock, status

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Get orders with buyer, items, shipping, payments

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: List buyer questions, filter by status

tools.name: manage_ads
tools.description: Activate, pause, or check Product Ads status

tools.name: traid_feature_lookup
tools.description: Search reusable engineering features from the TRAID knowledge catalog

tools.name: traid_client_context
tools.description: Get operational metadata for the current TRAID client project
